fee_notes: Startup franchises pay $62,750 total (comprising a $1,000 application fee, $37,000 initial license fee, $18,000 initial training fee, and $7,020 Initial Software Fee). Conversion franchises (existing book of business of at least $100,000 in revenue) pay $3,500–$38,250 (comprising $1,000 application fee, $2,500–$12,500 initial license fee, $0–$18,000 training fee, and $0–$7,020 Initial Software Fee). Qualifying veterans under VetFran receive a $4,000 reduction on the startup fee, resulting in a $52,000 total initial fee ($33,000 initial license fee). Padgett reserves the right to negotiate a modified initial franchise fee for pilot program participants on a case-by-case basis. The $1,000 application fee is refundable only if Padgett elects not to issue a franchise within 60 days or the applicant withdraws before signing; all other fees are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: Startup Franchises must pay PADGETT $62,750 for initial fees if you are starting a PADGETT business with no current clients. ... You must pay PADGETT $3,500 to $38,250 in initial fees for a conversion franchise. These fees consist of an initial application fee of $1,000, initial license fee of $2,500-$12,500, a training fee of $0-$18,000, and an Initial Software Fee of $0 - $7,020.
